acf.speaker_position: Customer Engineer at Google Cloud (Smart Analytics & ML)

blocks.html:
10+ years experience in Data Analytics, from a developer in a startup in Asia, through SAP BI consultant for largest manufacturing and FMCG customers and CTO for global AdTech startup. In Google I've build from ground-up Google Analytics 360 business in CEE and now, for the last 3 years, working with biggest customers in Poland to transform their Data Analytics on Google Cloud as a Customer Engineer.

My background is technical (MSc in Automatics and Robotics) with a dose of humanistic curiosity (BA in Sociology and fellow at Leadership Academy for Poland)
